summary.name: Jan
summary.one_liner: Jan is an open-source alternative to ChatGPT that runs open AI models locally on your computer or connects to cloud models such as GPT, Claude and Gemini.
use_cases: chat with open models offline on your computer
use cloud models like GPT or Claude from one app
keep AI conversations private on local hardware
replace a paid ChatGPT subscription with a free app
summary.what_it_does: The page describes Jan as a chat interface where you can choose from open models such as Llama, Mistral, Qwen, DeepSeek, Gemma and Kimi, or plug in online models like ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and Mistral AI. It says Jan carries context and preferences across conversations so you do not need to repeat yourself. The page states Jan is free and open source and reports over 7.2 million downloads. The awesome-mac listing says it runs entirely offline on your computer. The page does not detail installation steps or specific system requirements.
notable: Runs open models locally and can also connect to cloud providers like OpenAI, Anthropic and Google
Remembers user context and preferences across conversations
Open source with over 7.2M downloads per the page
caveats: The page does not name supported operating systems; the awesome-mac listing implies macOS
Cloud models require accounts or API access with those providers, which the page does not detail
